data.body: Fixed: Added test-coupling philosophy disagreement severity ceiling to reviewer-base.md Severity Calibration Rubric (four-criterion test: refactoring violation, tautological assertion, isolation failure, or regression blindness must be met to emit important). Updated reviewer-delta-test-quality.md severity rules to require the four-criterion test before flagging change-detector or implementation-coupled assertions as important, with concrete examples of misapplied important findings. Updated reviewer-delta-deep-verification.md with test-coupling severity discipline. Agent files rebuilt from updated sources.
